bullets: Scan the original image using the 3x3 filter
Move the filter ONE pixel  (Right, Left, Up, Down) and Re-Calculate
equations: I(x, y) ∗ h = Σ_{i=−a}^{a} Σ_{j=−b}^{b} I(x − i, y − j) ∘ h(i, j)
LaTeX: I(x,y) \ast h = \sum_{i=-a}^{a} \sum_{j=-b}^{b} I(x-i,\ y-j) \circ h(i,j)   [the operator between I(...) and h(i,j) is a small raised circle/dot, ∘ or \cdot]

layout.arrangement: Video-frame slide with black letterbox bars at very top and bottom. White slide outlined by a thin dark-red frame. Title centered at top. Below, one large red-outlined panel spans nearly the full width and is organized in three columns: LEFT column = 'Original image' photo with 5x5 numeric overlay, then 'Convolutional filter 1' 3x3 yellow grid with 'a=1, b=1' annotation, then two notation lines ('Image: I (x,y)' / 'Filter: h (-a:a , -b:b) (odd dimension)'). CENTER column = 'Convolving the image' 5x5 grid (top-left 3x3 highlighted yellow, remaining 16 cells green) with the convolution equation and red 'Inner product' brace label beneath it. RIGHT column = 'Result' 3x3 mostly-empty grid whose top-left cell contains '4', reached by a curved black arrow from the center grid. Bottom: a blue-outlined box with two instruction lines.
